snippet.title: Pyramid of Doom - (1979) - TRS-80 - WIN!
snippet.description:
➨ Follow me on Instagram: http://www.instagram.com/vghchannel/ 
➨ Donate: http://paypal.me/vghchannel
 ⇩  Click "SHOW MORE" for details and review

Adventure International © 1979
By: Scott Adams
[Computer] TRS-80 Model 1, Level II
Emulator:  MAME 0.215
Rating: 6/10

Other than the title inspiring comic-style readings… "Pyramid of Dooooom!" the game itself is a typical treasure-hunt Adventure by Scott Adams.  The setting this time is a pyramid in the desert, which one of the hardest things about it figuring out how to get inside the darn thing.  Only four locations you start out in, and since you're in the desert you really don't envision this "puddle of water" as something you can swim in.  

So those are somewhat standard issues you run into with this 2-word parser, early text adventure stuff.  But if you like this sort of game, or if you are existing only in 1979, these are games that are worth owning and playing.  Little else is available which is as engaging and fun on primitive systems.  So I like it… and I'm certainly impressed that Scott Adams is already up to 8 complete adventures before the end of 1979!
